equations.background: gamma=Omega_g*H0^2; U=Omega_ur*H0^2; M=(Omega_b+Omega_cdm)*H0^2; Lambda=Omega_lambda*H0^2. rho_gamma=gamma*a^-4; rho=gamma*a^-4+U*a^-4+M*a^-3+Lambda+rho_nu+rho_scf. p=(gamma+U)*a^-4/3-Lambda+p_nu+p_scf; H^2=rho-K/a^2; ell=-3*(rho+p)/(2*H^2)+K/(a^2*H^2).
equations.coordinate: u=ln(a), a=1/(1+z); H is CLASS Mpc^-1; Hs=H*c/metres_per_Mpc.
equations.ede: X=phi_prime/a; phi_u=X/H; X_u=-3*X-Vphi/H. rho_scf=(X^2/2+V)/3; p_scf=(X^2/2-V)/3. V=4152.39*m^2*F^2*(1-cos(kappa*phi/F))^3+B*3.968e-8; kappa=2.435e27. E=X^2/2+V obeys E_u=-3*X^2.
equations.ncdm_distribution: f0(q)=(2*pi)^-3*((exp(q-xi)+1)^-1+(exp(q+xi)+1)^-1). Replace sums by integrals with the same effective factor. Both versions satisfy rho_nu,u=-3*(rho_nu+p_nu).
equations.ncdm_native: mu=a*M_ncdm; rho_nu=factor*a^-4*sum(q_j^2*sqrt(q_j^2+mu^2)*w_j); p_nu=factor*a^-4*sum(q_j^4*w_j/(3*sqrt(q_j^2+mu^2))). Nodes/weights are fixed for each declared realization.
equations.onset: At admitted z_H=2870: carry w continuously, q0=x_HeI_Saha-1=2*f*r/(1+r+sqrt((1+r)^2+4*f*r)); h subsequently from existing M01 hydrogen root.
equations.thermal: Trad=T0/a; w=1-Tmat/Trad=-D_Tmat/Trad; beta=(8*sigma_T/(3*m_e*c))*rho_gamma*Jm3_over_Mpc2/Hs*x/(1+f+x). Early brec: w_u=w+(ell+3)/beta. He1/He1f/He2: w_u=1-(1+beta)*w. No exotic/variable-constant/IDM terms in this reduced variant.

finite_certificate_method.ede_jacobian: For y=(phi,X), H_phi=Vphi/(6*H), H_X=X/(6*H). J11=-X*Vphi/(6*H^3); J12=1/H-X^2/(6*H^3); J21=-Vphiphi/H+Vphi^2/(6*H^3); J22=-3+Vphi*X/(6*H^3). finite_certificate_method.forcing_cells: Partition finite u domain. For each cell record outward H,Hs,rho_gamma,rho+p,ell enclosures and source/Theta links. H_lower>0, rho_gamma_lower>0. Do not interpolate unsigned native sample errors into a proof.
finite_certificate_method.matrix_tail: For alpha=||N||_infty*dt and Taylor degree k with alpha<k+2, scalar norm remainder <= alpha^(k+1)/(k+1)!/(1-alpha/(k+2)). Add outward remainder per entry. Scale/dyadically split if needed; cap work with explicit UNRESOLVED rather than clipping.
finite_certificate_method.mode_transfer: Use source-defined boundaries and reset map with certified u(z) conversion. D/w carry at continuous photon temperature; q is introduced only at H onset through the algebraic preceding He2 root. Enclose uncertain transition location if applicable. finite_certificate_method.neutrino_interior: On finite [0,Q], integrate interval ranges on rational cells: sum(cell_width*[integrand(cell,mu,xi)]). All endpoints/exp/sqrt outward. Avoid 0/0 at q=mu=0; pressure is continuously zero and bounded by q^3*f0/3. Compare native sum enclosure to integral enclosure to obtain deterministic quadrature error; do not infer it from tol_ncdm_bg or node count.
finite_certificate_method.neutrino_tail: For mu<=mu_max, Axi=2*cosh(xi)/(2*pi)^3: density tail <= Axi*exp(-Q)*(P3(Q)+mu_max*P2(Q)); pressure tail <= Axi*exp(-Q)*P3(Q)/3; P2=Q^2+2Q+2, P3=Q^3+3Q^2+6Q+6. Multiply factor*a^-4 outward. This bound requires the admitted analytic FD distribution; not arbitrary file distributions.
finite_certificate_method.ode_defect: For polynomial predictor p on a cell, outward bound p-p_initial, p_prime-F(u,p,Theta,forcing) and J on the whole prospective tube, not only nodes. Existing Bernstein bounds may be reused. Initial-state, parameter, forcing, approximation and arithmetic errors are deterministic components of the total defect/enclosure.
finite_certificate_method.scalar_error: D+|e|<=L*|e|+delta where L=sup partial_w G. R(s)=exp(L*s)*R0+delta*J(L,s); J=(exp(L*s)-1)/L for L!=0 and J=s for L=0. Max_{0<=s<=dt}R(s)=max(R0,R(dt)) for fixed L,R0,delta>=0 except L may be signed; enforce p(cell)+[-Rmax,Rmax] strictly inside the prospective domain.
finite_certificate_method.thermal_derivative: x_r=(B-x)/(2*x+r-A); r*x_r/x=(x-A)/(2*x+r-A)<=eta=(B-A)/(2*B-A). beta_w<=0. Full-mode G_w=-1-beta-w*beta_w <= -1-beta*(1-c_pre), c_pre=w_bar/(1-w_bar)*eta*(3/2+I/Tmin), for 0<=w<=w_bar<1 and Tmin>0. Contraction only if c_pre<1; otherwise use finite-growth certificate. Early G_w=1-(ell+3)*beta_w/beta^2 >=1 when ell+3>=0.
finite_certificate_method.vector_error: Signed diagonal J_ii upper and absolute off-diagonal upper form a Metzler M. R(s)=exp(M*s)R0+integral_0^s exp(M*v)*delta dv. Finite growth is allowed. A safe all-time envelope is exp(N*dt)*(R0+dt*delta), N=M+sigma*I>=0, sigma=max(0,-min M_ii). Strict tube containment, not M*B+delta<=0, closes the proof.
